public_rationale: The available financial reporting does not establish this sector-wide quarterly comparison. OpenAI's annualized revenue and full-year loss forecasts are different measures, and the claim names no accounting basis. Research already documented useful customer-support outcomes, which weighs against a blanket dismissal of utility. Those findings do not establish full net returns or settle the narrower assertion about cost-justified complex problems.
limitations: The financial source is a secondary summary; the original report was inaccessible.
Run rate, full-year forecasts, and corporate segment totals cannot substitute for the claimed comparison.
The cited deployment predates the target quarter and lacks a complete cost-benefit calculation.

criteria.contradiction_condition: Comparable financial records refute the claimed shortfall, or credible deployment evidence establishes cost-justified solutions to complex problems within the claimed scope. A financial verdict also requires an identifiable accounting basis.
